Ghostty production VT dependency notices
========================================

Scope and provenance
--------------------
This notice covers the object graph observed in libghostty-vt.a from Ghostty
source revision 5de703a1b6ca0b91fcebe932b44be1df2de0a683. The static archive
contains Ghostty VT objects plus compiled uucode, Wuffs, simdutf, and Highway
objects. translate-c and its aro helper participate in the build graph but are
not production archive objects.

Provenance checks establish pinned source/archive metadata and successful probe
replay. They do not establish binary integrity: the available receipt has no
output hashes and does not prove that the installed static library, dynamic
library, or header is byte-for-byte derived from that build.

Build helpers (not production archive objects)
----------------------------------------------
translate-c 4e879eb8aba615de112eabd1231ea6e01920cead and its aro helper
participate in the pinned build graph. They are retained here because their
package wrappers are part of the observed graph.
